title: Future essentials: being, having, doing, going and knowing
summary: Use ser-, aur-, fer-, ir- and saur- to make practical plans and predictions.
objectives: Recall all six future forms of five essential verbs.
Distinguish j'irai from je vais and je saurai from je serai.

sources.label: University of Texas: irregular future stems

sections.title: Irregular stems, regular endings
paragraphs: These five verbs do not build the future from their infinitives. Learn a short stem ending in r and attach the same six endings as before. Être uses ser-, avoir aur-, faire fer-, aller ir- and savoir saur-. Il, elle and on share a form.

Savoir means know a fact or know how to do something. Savoir plus an infinitive can express acquired ability, not just future permission. Pouvoir, taught separately, expresses being able because circumstances allow it. Vocabulary: une réponse (feminine), an answer; un stage (masculine), an internship or training course.
points: Do not confuse serai (will be) with saurai (will know).
Je ferai has one r; it is not faire + -ai.

mistakes.why: For the requested simple future, faire uses fer- plus -ez.
Knowing an answer needs savoir; serai means will be.

sections.title: Use a future form to make a commitment
paragraphs: A future form is useful when you commit to a task, predict a state or say when information will become available. It is not a guarantee: the tense presents the event as future, while context shows how certain it is.

Je vais partir is a near-future construction: present aller plus an infinitive. J'irai au bureau is the simple future of going somewhere. J'irai chercher le dossier means I will go and fetch the file: the future verb still describes going, followed by another action.
points: Après le stage, vous saurez réparer... concerns a skill learned by then.
Keep the future in a future quand clause: quand nous aurons la réponse.

examples.english: I will be available after four p.m.

examples.french: Quand nous **aurons** les résultats, nous **ferons** le bilan.
examples.english: When we have the results, we will take stock.
examples.note: Both clauses refer to future events.

examples.french: Vous **irez** chercher les badges à l'accueil.
examples.english: You will go and collect the badges at reception.
examples.note: Irez expresses going, with chercher as the following action.

examples.french: Après cet atelier, ils **sauront** régler la machine.
examples.english: After this workshop, they will know how to adjust the machine.
examples.note: Savoir plus an infinitive expresses know-how.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the simple future: Je ___ à l'accueil.
Supply avoir in the simple future: Tu ___ ton badge demain.
Supply faire in the simple future: Nous ___ une pause.
Which sentence says we will go there, using the simple future?
practice.explanation: Irons is the simple future; allons is present.

practice.prompt: Supply savoir in the simple future: Vous ___ utiliser cet outil.
Supply être in the simple future: Les salles ___ ouvertes.
practice.explanation: A plural noun subject uses seront.

practice.prompt: Supply avoir in the simple future: Nous ___ besoin d'aide.
practice.explanation: Avoir besoin keeps avoir, conjugated aurons.

practice.prompt: Supply faire in the simple future: Elle ___ les réservations.
Supply aller in the simple future: Vous ___ directement au laboratoire.
Supply savoir in the simple future: On ___ demain si le projet continue.
practice.explanation: On uses the third-person singular saura.

practice.prompt: Supply aller in the simple future: J'___ chercher les documents.
Choose the form meaning they will know, not they will be: Ils ___ la date exacte lundi.
Supply faire in the simple future: Vous ___ le point avec l'équipe.
practice.explanation: Ferez is the vous future of faire.

practice.prompt: Supply avoir in the simple future: Quand elle ___ la confirmation, elle réservera.
practice.explanation: The future time clause uses aura.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the simple future: Nous ___ prêts à neuf heures.
Supply savoir in the simple future: Tu ___ bientôt réparer ton vélo.
practice.explanation: Sauras plus an infinitive describes future learned ability.

production_task.prompt: Write five short sentences telling a new colleague what will happen during induction. Use each of être, avoir, faire, aller and savoir once in the simple future.
production_task.model_answer: Vous serez avec notre équipe lundi. Vous aurez un badge personnel. Nous ferons le tour du bâtiment. Ensuite, vous irez au laboratoire. À la fin de la journée, vous saurez utiliser le logiciel.
production_task.translation: You will be with our team on Monday. You will have a personal badge. We will tour the building. Then you will go to the laboratory. By the end of the day, you will know how to use the software.
rubric: Use the five distinct stems accurately.
Choose endings for the intended subjects.
Make the induction sequence practical and clear.
